artist.name: Heidi Conrod
artist.bio: Heidi Conrod is an Ottawa-based mixed media artist whose practice lives in the space between — between eras, between media, between the painted surface and the glowing tube. For 30+ years she has been building a body of work that refuses to sit still. Her current series embeds hand-moulded electric neon directly onto abstract paintings. The neon doesn't decorate the canvas. It charges it.

work.title: Orange Wedge
work.medium: Acrylic and neon light element on canvas
work.description: A warm wedge of colour anchored by a hand-moulded neon element that simultaneously divides the space and makes it breathe. Neither flat nor sculptural — in between.

curatorNote: Heidi's work is the visual equivalent of what NOIZY is trying to do in sound — take something physical and human and wire it with energy without losing the hand. The neon IS the nerve.
